citation: A U.S. public school year of about 180 days (most states require 175 to 180; NCES State Education Reforms, Table 5.14), from late August or early September to late May or June, with a winter break and a spring break.
holidaysCitation: Federal holidays schools close for, by their rules in 5 U.S.C. 6103: Labor Day (first Monday in September), Thanksgiving (fourth Thursday in November, with the Friday after as most districts do), Martin Luther King Jr. Day and Washington's Birthday (third Mondays of January and February), Memorial Day (last Monday in May).
